title: brain-launch: Windows-aware python interpreter fallback when no venv exists
description: Reviewer LOW from TASK-073 (2026-07-01). When neither venv layout is found, bin/brain-launch.js falls back to the hard-coded interpreter python3 for the --health probe and the -m module fallback. On typical Windows installs python3 is not on PATH (python or the py launcher are), so a venv-less Windows box gets ENOENT instead of a useful degradation. Make the no-venv fallback platform-aware (e.g. process.platform === win32 -> python, else python3; optionally try the py launcher) while keeping POSIX behavior unchanged. Rebuild dist/brain-launch.cjs.
acceptance_criteria: On win32 with no venv, buildLaunchPlan selects a Windows-resolvable interpreter (python or the py launcher) instead of python3; POSIX fallback remains python3.
Spec coverage via the injected exists()/platform seam (platform-independent test).
